description: Where the signals that the System page no longer shows live in Grafana: the dashboards, their rows, and Explore views for traces, the service map and logs. Set as the home dashboard.

options.content:
# Where the System page went

The System page keeps the health verdict, the services table, the queues and the search index. Everything else is in Grafana, in the places below.

| Used to be on the System page | Open in Grafana |
| --- | --- |
| Requests per second, errors, p95 and DB pool per service; KPI tiles; traffic chart | [RED per service: Service Overview](/d/pc-service-overview) (rows Traffic and errors, HTTP server latency and Database client; choose services in the Service variable) |
| Latency heatmap | [Service Overview, Latency heatmap row](/d/pc-service-overview?viewPanel=panel-19) |
| Service map and its RED table | [Service map in Explore](/explore?schemaVersion=1&orgId=1&panes=%7B%22pc%22%3A%7B%22datasource%22%3A%22tempo%22%2C%22queries%22%3A%5B%7B%22refId%22%3A%22A%22%2C%22datasource%22%3A%7B%22type%22%3A%22tempo%22%2C%22uid%22%3A%22tempo%22%7D%2C%22editorMode%22%3A%22code%22%2C%22queryType%22%3A%22serviceMap%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%22%7D%5D%2C%22range%22%3A%7B%22from%22%3A%22now-1h%22%2C%22to%22%3A%22now%22%7D%7D%7D), or [Service Overview, Service map row](/d/pc-service-overview?viewPanel=panel-21) |
| Traces tab (root requests and messages, health checks left out) | [Trace search in Explore](/explore?schemaVersion=1&orgId=1&panes=%7B%22pc%22%3A%7B%22datasource%22%3A%22tempo%22%2C%22queries%22%3A%5B%7B%22refId%22%3A%22A%22%2C%22datasource%22%3A%7B%22type%22%3A%22tempo%22%2C%22uid%22%3A%22tempo%22%7D%2C%22editorMode%22%3A%22code%22%2C%22queryType%22%3A%22traceql%22%2C%22query%22%3A%22%7B%20nestedSetParent%20%3C%200%20%26%26%20%28kind%20%3D%20server%20%7C%7C%20kind%20%3D%20consumer%29%20%26%26%20span.url.path%20!~%20%5C%22%2Fhealth.*%5C%22%20%7D%22%2C%22limit%22%3A20%2C%22tableType%22%3A%22traces%22%7D%5D%2C%22range%22%3A%7B%22from%22%3A%22now-1h%22%2C%22to%22%3A%22now%22%7D%7D%7D) |
| Logs tab | [Log search in Explore](/explore?schemaVersion=1&orgId=1&panes=%7B%22pc%22%3A%7B%22datasource%22%3A%22loki%22%2C%22queries%22%3A%5B%7B%22refId%22%3A%22A%22%2C%22datasource%22%3A%7B%22type%22%3A%22loki%22%2C%22uid%22%3A%22loki%22%7D%2C%22editorMode%22%3A%22code%22%2C%22queryType%22%3A%22range%22%2C%22expr%22%3A%22%7Bservice_name%3D~%5C%22.%2B%5C%22%7D%22%7D%5D%2C%22range%22%3A%7B%22from%22%3A%22now-1h%22%2C%22to%22%3A%22now%22%7D%7D%7D) |
| Outbox lag | [Business Health, Outbox row](/d/pc-business-health) |
| Queue details (depth over time, consumer errors, dead letters) | [Business Health, Consumers and queues row](/d/pc-business-health) |
| Messaging spans and broker logs | [Async Messaging](/d/pc-async-messaging) |

The Explore links open the last hour with the Tempo or Loki datasource already selected. To narrow a view to one service, use the Service variable on Service Overview, or search Explore by `resource.service.name`.
